title: Reset demo from a non-dashboard demo page strands the page on the loading spinner forever
evidence:
fn reset_demo(model: Model) -> #(Model, Effect(Msg)) {
  case demo_store.seed() {
    Ok(store) -> {
      ...
          vacancy_detail: NotAsked,
          leaderboard: NotAsked,
          application_detail: NotAsked,
          comparison_details: NotAsked,
          archived_vacancies: NotAsked,
          awaiting_list: NotAsked,
          notifications: NotAsked,
          toasts: [],
        ),
        demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications),
 ... and client/src/pages/vacancy_detail.gleam:26: `NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()`
detail: The banner's Reset demo button (demo_banner.gleam, on_click UserClickedResetDemo) renders on every demo page via the shell. reset_demo blanks the detail/comparison/archived RemoteData but neither navigates to /demo nor refetches the current route's data, and demo AppPolledData is a no-op — so resetting while on a vacancy/application detail, comparison, or archived page leaves a permanent loading spinner. The demo_reset test only exercises the dashboard route.
recommended_fix: In reset_demo, modem.push("/demo") after reseeding (or refetch the current route's data via demo_entry_effects(store, model.route)) so non-dashboard pages repopulate.

title: /billing reachable in demo mode via direct URL fires a real settings_api.fetch_billing_history network call
detail: handle_browser_change's Billing case has no demo_mode branch (unlike Dashboard/VacancyDetail/VacancyEdit/Archived, which all got `// demo:` store branches), and the effect fires directly so demo_update never intercepts it. The shell hunks hide the settings link in demo but don't guard the route: an in-demo user typing /billing (BrowserChangedUrl keeps demo_mode True for non-public routes) triggers a real authenticated-endpoint call with no session, breaching the demo-no-network pillar; the demo/ grep lint can't see it since the call site is client.gleam.
recommended_fix: Add a demo branch to the Billing route case (skip fetch_billing_history / return empty billing history from the store), or treat Billing/Settings as demo-exit routes in BrowserChangedUrl.
